english.title: Fail to dispose of condemned / forfeited goods as directed by the Commissioners
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), not being an officer, failed to dispose of something

(A)_[seized]_
(B)_[detained]_

under the customs and excise Acts and condemned or deemed to have been condemned or forfeited, namely **(..SPECIFY THE THING SEIZED / DETAINED..), in such manner as directed by the Commissioners
english.legislation: Contrary to section 139(5) and (7) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
